verdict.rationale: The docs provide a static client SDK reference. It includes method tables (create_task, run_tasks_until_done, chat-session methods) and copy-pasteable Python snippets you can run locally after installing edison-client and creating an API token. There is no evidence of an interactive in-browser explorer, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: interactive in-browser API explorer/try-it console, published OpenAPI spec, examples executable directly from the reference, independent corroboration.
